hook: Waiting for your life to calm down before you start — that is the discipline problem, not a reason to postpone it.
topic: The Ideal Conditions Trap / Avoidance as Delay
body:
**There is always a reason the timing isn't right.**

Work is too demanding right now. The kids are at a difficult stage. Things will be more settled in a few months. When the situation changes, you'll have the space to do this properly.

This is the cleanest form of avoidance there is, because it sounds responsible. It sounds like planning.

It is not planning. It is postponement with a reasonable explanation attached — and the explanation will still be there in six months, wearing different clothes.

Here is the actual truth: a man who cannot build a standard in imperfect conditions will not build one in perfect conditions, because perfect conditions do not exist and have never existed.

Discipline does not require a clean window of time. It requires a decision, followed by a kept commitment, in whatever circumstances actually exist.

The chaos is not the obstacle. The chaos is the training ground.

Every man with a working discipline system built it inside a life that was already happening — messy, demanding, imperfect. Not after it settled. During it.

Start now. In exactly the life you have.
visual_direction: Marcus delivers the line "wearing different clothes" without humour — it lands as a precise observation, not a joke. Stillness throughout.
